@sketch
Feature: Point

  @cancel @documented_observation @needs_fixture
  Scenario: point-03 Cancel before placing a point
    Given the MCAD Software is running
    And an editable planar sketch is active
    And Point is active with Select center point
    When the user press Escape twice without clicking the canvas
    And the user right-click empty canvas to inspect state
    Then the status is Ready and the menu offers Repeat Point, Center Point
    And no new point marker is retained
    When the user press Escape
    Then the Ready-state menu closes

  @documented_observation @needs_fixture @undo_redo
  Scenario: point-04 Undo and redo the recorded placement
    Given the MCAD Software is running
    And an editable planar sketch is active
    And a center point remains after placement and Escape
    When the user press Ctrl+Z
    Then the point cross disappears
    When the user press Ctrl+Y
    Then the point cross returns at its prior visible location

  @documented_observation @needs_fixture @repeatability
  Scenario: point-05 Continue regular point placement without restarting Point
    Given the MCAD Software is running
    And an editable planar sketch is active
    And the Format Center Point toggle is off
    When the user invoke Point
    Then the prompt is Select Sketch Point
    When the user click two separate canvas positions
    Then both dot-style markers appear
    And Point remains available after each placement
    When the user press Escape
    Then Ready is displayed with both point markers retained

  @conversion @documented_observation @needs_fixture
  Scenario: point-06 Convert a regular sketch point to a center point and back
    Given the MCAD Software is running
    And an editable planar sketch is active
    And a regular dot-style sketch point and a separate unchanged point
    When the user right-click the first point and choose Center Point
    Then its selected marker is a cross
    And reopening its context menu shows Center Point checked
    When the user choose Center Point again
    Then the first point returns to a dot marker
    And the separate point retains its dot marker at its displayed location

  @conversion_undo_redo @documented_observation @needs_fixture
  Scenario: point-07 Undo and redo point-type conversion
    Given the MCAD Software is running
    And an editable planar sketch is active
    And the user have converted a regular sketch point to Center Point
    When the user press Ctrl+Z
    Then the point returns to its dot marker
    When the user press Ctrl+Y
    Then the point is a Center Point again
    When the user reopen the point context menu
    Then Center Point is checked

  @creation_mode @documented_observation @needs_fixture
  Scenario: point-08 Create a center point using the Format toggle
    Given the MCAD Software is running
    And an editable planar sketch is active
    And no geometry is selected and Center Point is enabled in Format
    When the user invoke Point
    Then the prompt is Select center point
    When the user click empty canvas and press Escape
    Then a center point remains at that location
    And existing regular points retain their dot-style type

  @documented_observation @edge_case @needs_fixture @undo_redo
  Scenario: point-10 Resolve repeated center-point placement at the same coordinates
    Given Point is active with Select center point
    And the observed sketch fixture shows 208 dimensions needed
    When the user click the same canvas location twice and press Escape
    Then no validation dialog appears
    And the coordinate HUD displays sketch X -21.229 mm and Y 10.444 mm for both clicks
    And the sketch shows 210 dimensions needed
    When the user undo the most recent placement
    Then the sketch still shows 210 dimensions needed
    When the user undo the earlier placement
    Then the sketch shows 208 dimensions needed
    When the user redo each placement separately
    Then the count changes to 210 and remains at 210
    When the user open Select Other at the overlapping location and expand its candidate list
    Then the list contains two point candidates

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: point-11 Cancel a center-point command with one Escape in the later fixture
    Given Point is active with Select center point in the recorded sketch
    When the user press Escape without placing a point
    And the user right-click empty canvas to inspect the refreshed state
    Then Ready is displayed and the menu offers Repeat Point, Center Point
    And no new point marker is visible
    When the user press Escape
    Then the menu closes and Ready remains displayed

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: point-12 Inspect Precise Input while Point is active
    Given Point is active in an editable sketch
    When the user expand the Create panel
    Then Precise Input is available
